<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1024
Claimant:
Erica Holland
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
12/12/2024
The claimant reported a left turn collision at an intersection, and the other driver's account matches this description. I
opened the file and requested the police report and photos of both vehicles.
01/04/2025
Photos from the scene show damage to the front of the other vehicle and the driver side of the claimant's car, which
fits the impact described. The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
02/08/2025
The claimant is not represented by a lawyer and handled the frist call directly. The claimant said they felt neck and
upper back discomfort within an hour and went to urgent care that evening.
02/09/2025
Two witnesses at the intersection gave statements confirming the signal timing and the path of each vehicle. Both
independently dsecribed the collision the same way the claimant did.
03/06/2025
The driver is named on the policy, and the policy was in force on the date of loss. Nothing suggests the damage
happened before the coverage started.
04/21/2025
I checked prior claims and medical history databases. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and no earlier injury
to the same body area is known.
06/13/2025
The claimant described the same sequence of events in the initial call, the written statement, and the follow-up
conversation. The account has stayed consitsent across every contact.
06/23/2025
The treating provider's notes describe a back strain consistent with the force of a side impact. Treatment followed a
usual course of physical therapy and tapered off as the patient improved.
06/26/2025
The claimant's account leaves some uncertainty about exactly where in the vehicle they were seated at impact, and I
have asked for a follow-up call to clarify this point.
07/05/2025
Based on the photos, witness statements, police report, and treatment records reviewed so far, the claim appears
consistent with the reported loss. I am moving the file to the next review stage pending the clarification on seating
position.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
